youtube_title: Jesus... I'm Always The One Who Texts First | Isaiah 49:15 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... I'm always the one who texts first. What happens if I just stop? 💔

She is always the one who texts first. Yesterday she stopped, and nobody noticed for a whole day.

She: Jesus... I'm always the one who texts first. What happens if I just stop? 💔

She: Yesterday I tried. Nobody checked on me. Twenty-four hours of nothing.

Jesus: You counted every hour, hoping someone would prove you matter. You never needed their proof.

She: But does nobody noticing mean nobody loves me?

Jesus: It means the people around you got comfortable being carried. Comfortable is not careless, but it still hurts.

She: So do I keep initiating, or let the friendships shrink to what they give back?

Jesus: Keep showing up, because that's who you are. But tell one friend the truth tonight: I miss being pursued too.

She: What if I say it and still nothing changes?

Jesus: Then hear this: I have pursued you every single day, and I have never once been too tired to text first.

Jesus: You are carved somewhere no one can forget. Start there tonight.

"“Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!"
Isaiah 49:15 (NIV)

Then hear this: I have pursued you every single day, and I have never once been too tired to text first.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

Who would notice if you went quiet? 💔 Tell us in the comments.
